description: Config is the flux-mirror configuration file.

artifacts.description: Artifacts lists OCI artifacts to mirror.

items.description: ArtifactEntry mirrors an OCI artifact (image, OCI chart, signed manifest, etc.).

destination.description: Destination is the OCI repository the artifact is mirrored to.

includeReferrers.description: IncludeReferrers also mirrors the artifact's referrers (signatures, SBOMs).

overwrite.description: Overwrite re-mirrors tags that already exist at the destination.

selector.description: Selector selects which tags to mirror.

limit.description: Limit caps how many tags are mirrored. 0 means unlimited.

regex.description: Regex applies a Go regexp prefilter to tags.

extract.description: Extract is the named capture group used as the sort/semver value.

pattern.description: Pattern is the Go regexp applied to tags.

semver.description: Semver is a semver constraint applied after the regex prefilter.

sortBy.description: SortBy selects the sort strategy: semver, alphabetical, or numerical.

source.description: Source is the OCI repository the artifact is mirrored from.

verify.description: Verify configures signature verification for source artifacts.

matchOIDCIdentity.description: MatchOIDCIdentity lists the Fulcio certificate identities to accept.

items.description: OIDCIdentity matches a Fulcio certificate identity.

issuer.description: Issuer is the OIDC issuer URL of the signing identity.

subject.description: Subject is a regexp matched against the certificate subject.

minAge.description: MinAge requires a signature to be at least this old before mirroring.

charts.description:
Charts lists Helm charts to mirror from an HTTP/S repository into an OCI
registry. Mirroring a chart that already lives in an OCI registry is an
OCI-to-OCI copy; configure it under Artifacts instead.

items.description:
ChartEntry mirrors a Helm chart from an HTTP/S repository to an OCI
destination. To mirror a chart that is already in an OCI registry, use an
ArtifactEntry instead (an OCI Helm chart is mirrored as a plain OCI artifact).

destination.description: Destination is the OCI repository URL the chart is mirrored to.

limit.description: Limit caps how many matching versions are mirrored. 0 means unlimited.

overwrite.description: Overwrite re-mirrors versions that already exist at the destination.

source.description: Source is the HTTP/S repository URL the chart is mirrored from.

version.description: Version is the semver constraint selecting which chart versions to mirror.

hosts.description:
Hosts configures per-host authentication for OCI registry requests, both
source pulls and destination pushes.

items.description:
RegistryHost binds an authentication method to a registry host. Credential and
Provider configure the HTTP-layer registry credential (mutually exclusive for a
cloud provider). TLS configures the transport-layer TLS/mTLS settings: it
composes with Credential and with the default (generic) Provider, but is
mutually exclusive with a cloud Provider — a cloud registry provider is a
managed registry whose transport flux-mirror does not customize. At least one
of Credential, a cloud Provider, TLS, or MaxChunkSize must be set.

credential.description: Credential configures the HTTP-layer registry credential for the host.

audiences.description: Audiences is the audience claim. Defaults to Host.

envelope.description:
Envelope transforms the resolved credential before it is sent to the
registry. It is a Go template whose data is a single Token field holding
the credential, with two functions available: base64 (standard base64)
and hex (lowercase hexadecimal). For example, "token-{{ hex .Token }}"
sends the hex-encoded credential with a token- prefix. An unset envelope
sends the credential unchanged.

expiration.description: Expiration is the jwkPath/jwkValue JWT lifetime. Defaults to 60s.

fromPath.description: FromPath sends a static JWT read from the file at the path.

issuer.description: Issuer is the issuer claim for jwkPath/jwkValue-signed tokens.

jwkPath.description: JWKPath signs a fresh JWT with the private JSON Web Key at the path.

jwkValue.description: JWKValue signs a fresh JWT with the private JSON Web Key read from the config.

provider.description:
Provider mints a per-request credential for the audiences, one of
JWTProviderGitHub, JWTProviderForgejo, JWTProviderGCP, JWTProviderAzure,
JWTProviderAWS, or JWTProviderSPIFFE.

subject.description: Subject is the subject claim for jwkPath/jwkValue-signed tokens.

type.description: Type is the kind of credential material (CredentialTypeJWT).

username.description:
Username presents the credential as the password of a username/password
pair. When unset, the credential is used as a bearer token.

value.description: Value sends a static JWT read from the config.

host.description: Host is the registry host (and optional port) the auth applies to.

maxChunkSize.description:
MaxChunkSize is the maximum size in KiB (1024 bytes) for an OCI blob
upload PATCH to this host; larger blobs are split into chunked PATCH
uploads. 0 (the default) disables chunking, sending a single monolithic
PATCH per blob. Useful for registries or proxies that cap request bodies.

provider.description:
Provider selects a cloud registry provider's workload-identity credentials
for the host: RegistryProviderECR, RegistryProviderACR, or
RegistryProviderGAR. Omitted (or RegistryProviderGeneric) means an ordinary
registry, for which flux-mirror configures the credential and/or TLS
directly. A cloud provider is mutually exclusive with Credential and TLS.

tls.description:
TLS configures transport-layer TLS for the host: server verification
(custom CA), client certificate (mTLS), or SPIFFE X.509-SVID mTLS.

certificate.description: Certificate is the static client certificate chain.

fromPath.description: FromPath reads the value from the file at the path.

key.description: Key is the static client private key.

fromPath.description: FromPath reads the private key from the file at the path.

value.description: Value reads the private key from the config.

provider.description:
Provider selects SPIFFE X.509-SVID client authentication
(TLSProviderSPIFFE). Unset selects the static Certificate and Key pair.

serverAuth.description: ServerAuth verifies the registry's server certificate.

fromPath.description: FromPath reads the CA bundle from the file at the path.

provider.description:
Provider selects SPIFFE server verification (TLSProviderSPIFFE). Unset
selects the file-based CA bundle from FromPath or Value.

spiffe.description: SPIFFE verifies the server's X.509-SVID against the SPIFFE trust bundle.

authorizeAny.description: AuthorizeAny accepts any SVID the bundle can validate (discouraged).

serverID.description: ServerID authorizes one exact SPIFFE ID.

trustDomain.description:
TrustDomain authorizes any SVID in the named trust domain; TrustDomainSelf
("self") uses the client's own trust domain.

value.description: Value inlines the PEM-encoded CA bundle.

title: Config is the flux-mirror configuration file.
